svg.title: Playback: Lightweight Discovery, On-Demand Continue and Queue Publication

g.text: Playback: Lightweight Discovery, On-Demand Continue and Queue Publication
read each device's current pointer and conflict versions (cache may hit)
validate checkpoints; observe all revision counters
exclude this device / tombstones; update sessions
no full queue is read at this stage; the UI filters by the current account
error for this operation; local playback kept
check device, revision relation, account, cursor
assemble PlaybackSession; release the previously selected queue cache
current account and that the record still exists
local playback is replaced only on success; the source device is not paused
[no valid session for the same account]
[session content / progress changed, or not yet published]
[this connection has no cache of this device's published queue]
read this device's old pointer and queue on demand
Old queue actually missing: the new session may publish.
Present but not downloaded or damaged: fail explicitly, never mask it.
[snapshot content unchanged and queue file exists]
progress, current track, cursor and repeat mode live in the checkpoint;
the queue is not copied again
[first maintenance on this connection, or 24 h since the last successful one]
coordinated read of current / conflict pointers;
remove orphaned queues older than 7 days
Kept: referenced by current / conflict / previous snapshot,
modified within 7 days, unknown file names.
No modification date: kept until a normal maintenance cycle.
Metadata / delete failures: logged; never fail publication or disconnect.
